biography:
My professional experience has been quite broad and I enjoy the challenge and opportunity to learn with each project.

My design project experience includes large data centers, central chilled water plants, HVAC for office build-outs, critical cooling for trading floors, restaurants, retail space, schools and classrooms, hospitals, laboratories, steam boiler systems and central power plants. 

Systems that I have been involved in designing include central air handling systems, chilled and condenser water systems, high and low pressure steam boiler systems, make-up and feedwater systems, plumbing systems, fire protection systems including wet pipe, dry-pipe preaction and FM200 and Nitrogen Gas suppressions systems and fuel-oil and natural gas systems.

I have provided construction support services for the above project types and served as the Engineering Project Manager for the construction and commissioning of the Barclays Global Investors Global Headquarters located in downtown San Francisco.

Finally, I have extensive experience providing commissioning services for all of the systems listed above with additional experience commissioning Uninterruptible Power Supply systems, emergency power systems, and electrical distribution systems.

Specialties: Data Center Critical Cooling Design and Commissioning
